games.title: Among Us
games.short_description: Work together to keep your ship alive — but watch out for the impostor.
games.about: A party game of teamwork and betrayal. Complete tasks aboard a spaceship with your crewmates, while one of you quietly sabotages everything and picks off the crew. Deduce, debate, and vote out the impostor — the ultimate social deduction game.
games.player_count: 500+ million players at its 2020 peak
trivia: It was released in 2018 but exploded in popularity in mid-2020
Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez played it live on Twitch to encourage voting
The words "sus" and "impostor" entered internet slang worldwide
Its crewmate design was inspired by a doodle of a jelly bean

games.title: Animal Crossing: New Horizons
games.short_description: Escape to a peaceful island paradise you can shape as you like.
games.about: Build your own island getaway, meet charming animal villagers, catch bugs and fish, decorate your home, and live life at your own pace. A gentle, ever-changing world that rewards daily visits and creativity — the ultimate cozy game.
games.player_count: 45+ million copies sold; best-selling Nintendo Switch exclusive
trivia: It became a cultural phenomenon during 2020's pandemic lockdowns
Players recreated famous museums, fashion shows, and even weddings on their islands
Turnip trading ("the Stalk Market") became a real economic mini-game for fans
A fan-made Animal Crossing run set a world record for most Bells earned

games.title: Apex Legends
games.short_description: A squad-based battle royale with fluid movement and unforgettable heroes.
games.about: Choose from a roster of legendary characters with unique abilities and fight in three-person squads across fast, fluid battle royale matches. With refined gunplay, innovative ping systems, and constant seasonal content, Apex remains a top competitive shooter.
games.player_count: 130+ million players worldwide
trivia: It launched with zero marketing and hit 25 million players in one week
Its ping system revolutionized communication in shooters
Characters like Wraith and Octane became pop-culture icons
Titanfall's wall-running movement was refined into Apex's slide and climb system

games.title: ARK: Survival Evolved
games.short_description: Tame dinosaurs and survive a mysterious prehistoric world.
games.about: Wake up on a mysterious island filled with dinosaurs and other survivors. Tame and ride creatures from the T-rex to the dragon, build fortresses, craft technology, and uncover the mysteries of ARK — solo or with up to ten-player tribes.
games.player_count: 35+ million copies sold
trivia: Players can tame and ride over 150 species of dinosaurs
Its lore reveals the island is actually a space station
The ARK survival of the fittest mode became an esports tournament
Vin Diesel narrated the game's 2023 sequel, ARK 2

games.title: Baldur's Gate 3
games.short_description: Gather your party and return to the Forgotten Realms in this epic RPG.
games.about: An epic narrative RPG set in the world of Dungeons & Dragons. Forge your destiny through hundreds of choices, turn-based tactical combat, and a sprawling story of up to 4-player co-op. Baldur's Gate 3 redefines what a CRPG can be, with unforgettable characters and truly reactive storytelling.
games.player_count: 15+ million copies sold; a record-breaking turn-based RPG
awards: Game of the Year 2023 (The Game Awards)
trivia: Over 170 hours of cinematic cutscenes — more than any game ever made
It was in early access for nearly 3 years, shaped by millions of player decisions
Larian's CEO Sven Vincke bought the D&D license personally after Wizards of the Coast passed
The Dark Urge origin can be played as an evil campaign with unique scenes

games.title: Cities: Skylines
games.short_description: The definitive modern city builder, with deep systems and endless creativity.
games.about: Design, build, and manage the metropolis of your dreams. With intricate traffic simulation, zoning, public services, and economy systems, Cities: Skylines is the deepest city builder ever made — and a relaxing creative sandbox all at once.
games.player_count: 12+ million copies sold
trivia: It was created as the long-awaited successor to SimCity after SimCity's 2013 flop
Every citizen is individually simulated, with a job, home, and commute
Its traffic system is so accurate it's used in urban planning lectures
Paradox turned it into a franchise with three major expansions and a sequel

games.title: Counter-Strike 2
games.short_description: The world's premier competitive FPS, rebuilt on a new engine.
games.about: Counter-Strike 2 is the largest technical leap in Counter-Strike history, with new volumetric smoke, upgraded maps, and reworked lighting. The definitive tactical shooter where precision, teamwork, and a thriving competitive scene make every round count.
games.player_count: 1.8+ million peak concurrent players on Steam; one of the most-played PC shooters
awards: Esports Game of the Year 2023 nominee
Longest-running competitive FPS franchise in history
trivia: Counter-Strike began as a Half-Life mod by Minh Le and Jess Cliffe in 1999
Its competitive format is still the industry's default for 5v5 shooters
Every map was rebuilt from scratch for Source 2
The economy system — earning money each round — remains a genre innovation

games.title: Cyberpunk 2077
games.short_description: An open-world action-adventure story set in Night City.
games.about: Become a cyberpunk mercenary in the megalopolis of Night City, where style and violence meet in a dystopian future. With the heart-pounding story of the Phantom Liberty expansion and the vibrant open world, Cyberpunk 2077 is a thrilling RPG of ambition, body modification, and neon-lit danger.
games.player_count: 30+ million copies sold; a comeback story after a rocky launch
trivia: Keanu Reeves' character Johnny Silverhand was written specifically for him
Its controversial 2020 launch led to class-action lawsuits and a PlayStation Store removal
The Phantom Liberty expansion, released in 2023, was widely praised as a redemption arc
Its Night City map was built with real city-planning software

games.title: Dark Souls III
games.short_description: The fires are fading in the brutal finale of the legendary Souls trilogy.
games.about: Journey to a dying world of crumbling kingdoms and monstrous lords of cinder. With ferociously demanding combat, intricate level design, and a haunting atmosphere, Dark Souls III is FromSoftware's acclaimed trilogy-capper — a challenge like nothing else.
games.player_count: 10+ million copies sold
awards: Golden Joystick Ultimate Game of the Year 2016 nominee
trivia: Its final DLC, The Ringed City, closes the entire Dark Souls saga
The soul level 1 run — beating the game without leveling — remains a legendary challenge
Firelink Shrine's music is an orchestral variation of the series' theme
Its combat is faster than Dark Souls 1 and 2, closer to Bloodborne

games.title: Dead by Daylight
games.short_description: Four survivors, one killer — a multiplayer horror where every match is a slasher film.
games.about: One player becomes the Killer; four must repair generators and escape. With iconic horror villains like Michael Myers and Leatherface, tense cat-and-mouse gameplay, and years of new content, Dead by Daylight is the definitive asymmetric horror game.
games.player_count: 60+ million players
awards: Best Multiplayer Game 2016 nominee (The Game Awards)
trivia: Licensed killers include Michael Myers, Leatherface, Nemesis, and Vecna
Each match is a slasher film with a different ending
Its fog, generators, and hooks are now genre shorthand
Behavior Interactive added original killers like The Trickster and The Artist

games.title: Death Stranding
games.short_description: Connect a fractured America as a legendary deliveryman.
games.about: In the aftermath of a catastrophe that blurred the line between life and death, sam porter Bridges crosses a hauntingly beautiful landscape to reconnect isolated cities. A one-of-a-kind journey about human connection, from the mind of Hideo Kojima.
games.player_count: 10+ million copies sold
trivia: Its terrain traversal — balancing cargo while walking — is the core gameplay
Players' structures appear in each other's worlds asynchronously
Norman Reedus, Mads Mikkelsen, and Léa Seydoux star in it
A sequel, Death Stranding 2, was announced at The Game Awards 2022

games.title: Devil May Cry 5
games.short_description: Over-the-top stylish action from the masters of the genre.
games.about: Three demon hunters — Nero, Dante, and the mysterious V — wage war against the demonic invasion of Red Grave City. With impossibly fluid combat, deep style rankings, and pure arcade spectacle, DMC5 is the pinnacle of character-action games.
games.player_count: 8+ million copies sold
awards: Best Action Game 2019 nominee (The Game Awards)
trivia: Its style meter grades attacks from "D" to "SSS"
V, a new character, fights with summoned beasts instead of weapons
The Special Edition added Vergil as a playable character
Its soundtrack adapts to how stylishly the player fights

games.title: DOOM Eternal
games.short_description: Rip and tear through hell in the most aggressive shooter ever made.
games.about: The legions of Hell have invaded Earth. As the Doom Slayer, you are the only thing standing between humanity and extinction. Chain together glory kills, devastating weapons, and relentless movement in a power-fantasy shooter that never lets up.
games.player_count: 10+ million copies sold
trivia: Its "Demon Slayer" combat loop was designed to feel like a first-person action figure set
Mick Gordon, the composer, built the soundtrack with analog synthesizers and guitar feedback
The Series X/S versions run at 120 fps in performance mode
It runs on Nintendo Switch thanks to a port by Panic Button

games.title: EA Sports FC 24
games.short_description: The world's game, with millions of players and the most realistic football yet.
games.about: Formerly FIFA, EA Sports FC 24 brings authentic football with real clubs, players, and leagues from around the world. With HyperMotionV technology, playing styles modeled on real pros, and modes like Ultimate Team and Career, it's the definitive football experience.
games.player_count: The best-selling sports game franchise in history
awards: Guinness World Record for best-selling sports game franchise (as FIFA)
trivia: It was the first entry after EA and FIFA ended their 30-year partnership
HyperMotionV technology captures real match data from 180 pro matches
Its "Ultimate Team" mode remains one of gaming's largest economies
The switch from FIFA to FC cost EA the World Cup license but freed it to rename clubs

games.title: Elden Ring
games.short_description: A vast fantasy world of wonder and peril awaits in FromSoftware's biggest adventure yet.
games.about: Rise, Tarnished, and be guided by grace to brandish the power of the Elden Ring. Explore the Lands Between, a breathtaking world filled with peril and wonder, and face demigods to become an Elden Lord. With deep, challenging combat and a vast open world co-created with George R. R. Martin, Elden Ring is a landmark action RPG.
games.player_count: 25+ million copies sold; one of the best-selling games of all time
awards: Game of the Year 2022 (The Game Awards)
trivia: Sold 12 million copies in under a month, faster than any FromSoftware game
Hidetaka Miyazaki collaborated with George R. R. Martin on the world's lore
Its horse, Torrent, cannot die — only be resummoned
Speedrunners have beaten the game in under 3 minutes

games.title: Fall Guys
games.short_description: Wobble, tumble, and scramble through chaotic obstacle-course battle royale.
games.about: Race through wild obstacle courses, bounce through team games, and survive elimination rounds against dozens of others — all as a adorable bean person. Free to play and irresistibly silly, Fall Guys is pure party-game joy.
games.player_count: 50+ million players in its first two weeks
awards: Best Multiplayer Game 2020 nominee (The Game Awards)
trivia: Its bean-shaped characters became instant memes
It launched free on PlayStation Plus, boosting it to record players
Mediatonic was acquired by Epic Games in 2021
Its crossover skins include Sonic, Godzilla, and Spider-Man

games.title: Fortnite
games.short_description: The cultural phenomenon battle royale with endless crossovers and modes.
games.about: Drop in, gear up, and be the last one standing in this massively popular battle royale. With constant content updates, wild collaborations, creative mode, and a vibrant, cartoonish style, Fortnite is free-to-play fun that has become a global social hangout.
games.player_count: 500+ million registered players; one of the most-played games in history
trivia: Travis Scott's 2020 in-game concert drew over 12 million live viewers
Its battle royale mode was built in two months by a small internal team
It popularized the "battle pass" model now used across the industry
Players have recreated entire cities, movie sets, and working arcade machines in Creative mode

games.title: Forza Horizon 5
games.short_description: Your epic Horizon adventure in the vibrant evolving open world of Mexico.
games.about: Explore the diverse landscapes of Mexico in the ultimate open-world racing adventure. Drive hundreds of world-class cars through living deserts, jungles, and historic cities, with stunning graphics, endless events, and a joyful celebration of speed and cars.
games.player_count: 40+ million players; the biggest launch in Xbox history
trivia: Its Mexico map is one of the most diverse racing game worlds ever, with volcano, jungle, and desert
The Forzavista mode lets players explore every car in photorealistic detail
It supports ray tracing on console and PC
Its festival hub lets players build custom courses for friends

games.title: Garry's Mod
games.short_description: A physics sandbox where the only limit is your imagination.
games.about: There are no goals — just you, a world of physics objects, and every tool you need. Play thousands of community-made game modes, from prop hunt to Trouble in Terrorist Town. Garry's Mod is the ultimate creative playground and a party-game institution.
games.player_count: 20+ million copies sold
awards: A cultural institution with over a decade of community content
trivia: It started as a free mod called Garry's Mod 9
The "Trouble in Terrorist Town" mode inspired Among Us' deduction gameplay
Its Prop Hunt mode became its own standalone game
The iconic "Dr. Kleiner" NPC model is reused in thousands of community videos

games.title: Ghost of Tsushima
games.short_description: Become the Ghost in a stunning open-world samurai epic.
games.about: In 1274, a Mongol invasion has devastated Tsushima. As samurai Jin Sakai, you must forge a new path — breaking tradition to fight with stealth and cunning. With gorgeous wind-guided exploration and cinematic sword combat, this is one of the most beautiful games ever made.
games.player_count: 13+ million copies sold
trivia: The wind literally guides players — no quest markers on screen
A fan petition asked Sony for a God of War-style exploration mode; it got one
Its multiplayer Legends mode was added free post-launch
The island of Iki in the DLC is based on a real Mongol invasion site

games.title: God of War Ragnarök
games.short_description: Kratos and Atreus journey through the Nine Realms as the end times approach.
games.about: The epic conclusion to the Norse saga. Father and son face the oncoming Ragnarök, traveling through breathtaking realms, battling gods and monsters, and grappling with what it means to be a father, a son, and a warrior. Combat is visceral, the storytelling is superb, and the visuals are stunning.
games.player_count: 15+ million copies sold; a flagship PlayStation exclusive
trivia: Its one-shot camera means the game never cuts during gameplay
Kratos was recast with Christopher Judge, best known as Teal'c in Stargate SG-1
The 2018 prequel won Game of the Year 2018; Ragnarok was its direct sequel
Squirrel Ratatoskr was voiced by Robot Chicken's Seth Green

games.title: Grand Theft Auto V
games.short_description: A sprawling satirical open world of crime and opportunity in Los Santos.
games.about: Follow three very different criminals — a retired bank robber, a street hustler, and a psychotic lunatic — through the sun-soaked city of Los Santos. With a massive open world, razor-sharp satire, endless activities, and the ever-popular GTA Online, GTA V remains one of the most played games ever made.
games.player_count: 200+ million copies sold; the second best-selling video game of all time
awards: Game of the Year 2013 (multiple outlets, including The Game Awards)
trivia: Three protagonists was a first for the series and a technical feat
Its music score blends hip-hop, rock, and electronic for every radio station
GTA Online's Heists update was delayed so long it became a running joke
The game world, Los Santos, is bigger than the combined maps of GTA IV, San Andreas, and Red Dead Redemption

games.title: Hades
games.short_description: Defy the god of the dead in this award-winning rogue-like dungeon crawler.
games.about: Battle out of the Greek underworld as the immortal prince of the Underworld, wielding the powers of Olympus in a story-rich, endlessly replayable escape attempt. Every death brings you closer to victory in this critically-acclaimed blend of fast action and rich narrative.
games.player_count: 10+ million copies sold; a genre-defining roguelike
awards: Hugo Award for Best Interactive Media 2021
trivia: It was the first video game ever to win a Hugo Award
Every death triggers new dialogue — over 20,000 voice lines total
The story of escaping the underworld is drawn straight from Greek mythology
Its voice cast included Logan Cunningham, long-time Supergiant collaborator

games.title: Hogwarts Legacy
games.short_description: Live the unwritten and attend Hogwarts in the 1800s.
games.about: Your character is a student who holds the key to an ancient secret. Explore an open world of Hogwarts, Hogsmeade, and the surrounding highlands, learn spells, brew potions, tame magical beasts, and shape your own legacy in the wizarding world — a full century before Harry Potter's story.
games.player_count: 30+ million copies sold
awards: Best Fantasy Game 2023 (The Game Awards nominee)
Golden Joystick PlayStation Game of the Year 2023
trivia: It is set in the 1890s, long before Harry Potter's era
Players can tame and ride Hippogriffs and Thestrals
The Room of Requirement serves as a base-building hub
It sold 12 million copies in its first two weeks despite controversy

games.title: Hollow Knight
games.short_description: A haunting, hand-drawn adventure through the ruins of a forgotten kingdom.
games.about: Explore twisting caverns, ancient cities, and deadly wastes in this atmospheric Metroidvania. Battle tainted creatures, befriend bizarre bugs, and uncover the ancient mystery at the heart of Hallownest. With beautiful hand-drawn art and challenging, precise combat, Hollow Knight is a modern classic.
games.player_count: 15+ million copies sold
awards: GDC Award for Best Visual Art 2018
trivia: It was funded on Kickstarter in 2014 with just $57,000
Team Cherry, the developer, is a three-person studio from Adelaide, Australia
Its hand-drawn art took years and inspired thousands of fan animations
The game's lore is deliberately left for players to piece together

games.title: It Takes Two
games.short_description: A mind-bending co-op adventure built entirely around two-player play.
games.about: Play as the clashing couple Cody and May, turned into dolls and trapped in a fantastical world. Forced to work together through wildly varied gameplay and creative challenges, this pure co-op adventure requires two players and delivers an unforgettable ride about teamwork and love.
games.player_count: 20+ million copies sold
awards: Game of the Year 2021 (The Game Awards)
trivia: It can only be played in co-op — no single-player mode exists
The Friend's Pass lets one buyer play with a friend for free
Its story is about a married couple turned into dolls working through divorce
A companion book, "It Takes Two: An Adventure in Creativity", accompanied its release

games.title: Left 4 Dead 2
games.short_description: The definitive four-player zombie co-op shooter.
games.about: Team up with three friends and blast through hordes of zombies in the legendary co-op shooter. With distinct special infected, endless replayability, and campaigns across the South, L4D2 remains the greatest zombie game ever made.
games.player_count: 15+ million copies sold
trivia: It was released just one year after the original — an unusually fast sequel
The AI "Director" adjusts pacing, spawns, and items to each play session
Its community Workshop adds thousands of custom campaigns
The four survivors of the first game return as playable characters in DLC

games.title: Minecraft
games.short_description: Build anything you can imagine in the world's most popular sandbox game.
games.about: Minecraft is a sandbox game of infinite creativity. Mine blocks, craft tools, build towering structures, and survive against monsters in a procedurally generated world of endless possibility. Play solo, join friends online, or explore countless community-made worlds and mods — there is truly something for everyone in this modern classic.
games.player_count: 300+ million copies sold; the best-selling video game of all time
awards: Named the best-selling game ever by Guinness World Records
trivia: Creepers were created by accident when a coding error made a pig too tall and too long
Its soundtrack by C418 is widely considered one of gaming's most iconic
There are over 140 million monthly active players worldwide
Players have built working computers, hard drives, and even 1-bit CPUs inside the game

games.title: Monster Hunter: World
games.short_description: Hunt colossal beasts in a living ecosystem of predators and prey.
games.about: Take on the role of a hunter stalked by gigantic monsters in vast, living landscapes. Track, trap, and battle fearsome creatures, craft ever-stronger gear from your kills, and team up with up to three friends in the most successful game in Capcom's history.
games.player_count: 25+ million copies sold; Capcom's best-selling game ever
trivia: It was the first Monster Hunter designed for a global audience
Each monster has an ecosystem — they hunt, eat, and fight each other
Its Palico cat companions can be customized with equipment
The Iceborne expansion added a whole new arctic continent

games.title: NBA 2K24
games.short_description: The most authentic basketball simulation, with all your favorite teams and stars.
games.about: Experience NBA basketball with lifelike graphics, authentic rosters, and deep game modes. Build a dynasty in MyCareer, relive Kobe Bryant's legendary career in Mamba Moments, and dominate the hardwood in this year's premier basketball sim.
games.player_count: The best-selling basketball video game franchise
awards: Sports Game of the Year nominee (multiple outlets, historic)
trivia: Kobe Bryant graces the cover for the Mamba Moments mode
ProPLAY technology animates real NBA footage into gameplay
Its MyCareer mode lets players live out an NBA story from high school to the Hall of Fame
The W mode focuses on WNBA careers for the first time in the series

games.title: Overwatch 2
games.short_description: A team-based hero shooter with a vibrant cast of unique heroes.
games.about: Team up and pick your hero from a diverse roster of tank, damage, and support characters, each with their own abilities and personality. With fast-paced objective-based matches and colorful, competitive action, Overwatch 2 is a polished, always-evolving hero shooter.
games.player_count: 35+ million players in its first year; one of the largest shooter communities
awards: Best Multiplayer Game 2022 (The Game Awards, for launch momentum)
trivia: It replaced the original Overwatch's 6v6 format with 5v5 squads
Every hero has a unique ultimate that can change the course of a team fight
It became free-to-play in October 2022 with a seasonal battle pass model
Kiriko's "Kitsune Rush" ultimate was inspired by Japanese folklore

games.title: Persona 5 Royal
games.short_description: A stylish JRPG about phantom thieves stealing corrupt hearts.
games.about: Lead a group of vigilante students who moonlight as the Phantom Thieves, entering a supernatural realm to change the hearts of corrupt adults. With razor-sharp style, a deep turn-based combat system, unforgettable characters, and a hundred hours of story, Persona 5 Royal is a modern JRPG landmark.
games.player_count: 8+ million copies sold (Persona 5 family)
awards: NAACP Image Award nominee for its jazz soundtrack
trivia: The soundtrack by Shoji Meguro blends acid jazz with rock and opera
Its calendar system means every in-game day matters
Persona 5's cast became so popular they crossed over into Smash Bros
The Royal version adds 30 hours of new content and a third semester

games.title: Portal 2
games.short_description: A landmark puzzle game of portals, physics, and perfect comedy writing.
games.about: Wield a portal gun to bend space, solve ingeniously designed test chambers, and unravel a story voiced by one of gaming's greatest villains. With a full separate co-op campaign, Portal 2 remains the gold standard for puzzle games — and for video game humor.
games.player_count: 10+ million copies sold
trivia: Stephen Merchant and J.K. Simmons voiced key characters
Its co-op campaign has an entirely separate story from the single-player
GLaDOS's passive-aggressive humor is considered one of gaming's best-written villains
A Valve engineer once hid a Portal 2 reference in an Arduino firmware update

games.title: PUBG: Battlegrounds
games.short_description: The original battle royale where 100 players fight to be the last one standing.
games.about: Drop onto an island, scavenge for weapons, and outlast 99 other players in the game that started the battle royale craze. With realistic gunplay, shrinking play zones, and tense, tactical firefights, every PUBG match is a story of survival.
games.player_count: 75+ million copies sold; 350+ million mobile players
awards: Best Multiplayer Game 2017 nominee (The Game Awards)
Esports Game of the Year 2018 nominee
trivia: It popularized the battle royale genre and inspired Fortnite and Apex
Brendan Greene, "PlayerUnknown", created the mode from Arma mods
The blue zone — a shrinking wall of electricity — became genre standard
PUBG Mobile has been downloaded over 1 billion times

games.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.short_description: America, 1899. The end of the Wild West era is near.
games.about: Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde gang are on the run. This sprawling epic of life in America's unforgiving heartland features a massive open world, deep characters, and a story of loyalty and betrayal. Every detail of this living world is crafted to draw you into the dying days of the outlaw era.
games.player_count: 65+ million copies sold; one of the best-selling games of all time
trivia: Every NPC has a daily routine, including going to work and eating dinner
Animal testicles shrink in cold weather — a detail widely reported by players
Its homage to the original Red Dead Redemption is woven into the story
RDR2's horse bonding system tracks care, grooming, and rider trust

games.title: Resident Evil 4 (2023)
games.short_description: Survival is just the beginning in this reimagining of a survival horror classic.
games.about: Special agent Leon S. Kennedy is sent to rescue the U.S. President's daughter from a sinister cult in rural Spain. This ground-up remake of the legendary survival horror game blends tense combat, resource management, and modernized storytelling into a relentless, heart-pounding experience.
games.player_count: 7+ million copies sold within a year
awards: Golden Joystick Ultimate Game of the Year 2023
trivia: The original 2005 Resident Evil 4 is widely considered one of the greatest games ever
The remake overhauls combat with modern parries and knife durability
Ashley's AI companion was rebuilt to feel like a real partner, not a burden
Ada Wong's Separate Ways campaign was re-released as DLC in 2023

games.title: Rocket League
games.short_description: Soccer meets driving in the high-flying, rocket-powered sports phenomenon.
games.about: Spring for the ball, wall-drive, backflip, and score impossible aerial goals in the world's most exciting vehicle-soccer hybrid. Free to play with fast matches, deep mechanics, and a thriving esports scene, Rocket League is endlessly replayable competition.
games.player_count: 90+ million players worldwide
trivia: It was made by a small studio in San Diego, later bought by Epic Games
Its "ranked" seasons run in competitive playlists year-round
Cars can be customized with over 1,000 cosmetic items
The rocket-powered car-soccer idea came from a 2008 game called Supersonic Acrobatic Rocket-Powered Battle-Cars

games.title: Rust
games.short_description: Survive, build, and betray in the world's most brutal survival game.
games.about: Wake up naked on a beach with a rock and a torch. Gather, build, raid, and defend against a world of ruthless players in the multiplayer survival game that made betrayal an art form. Harsh, unforgiving, and endlessly compelling.
games.player_count: 16+ million copies sold
trivia: Every player's skin color is assigned randomly and permanently
Its monthly forced server wipes reset the entire world
Raiding other players' bases is the endgame for most clans
It began as a DayZ-inspired clone, then became its own brutal identity

games.title: Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice
games.short_description: Hardened ninja combat in a beautifully brutal Sengoku-era Japan.
games.about: You are a shinobi bound to protect a young lord of an ancient bloodline, facing impossible odds. With precise, rhythm-based sword combat, a rich world of myth and stealth, and some of FromSoftware's most demanding boss fights, Sekiro rewards mastery like few other games.
games.player_count: 10+ million copies sold
awards: Game of the Year 2019 (The Game Awards)
trivia: It trades Souls games' RPG builds for pure swordsmanship skill
The resurrection mechanic — literally dying twice — gave the game its title
Shinobi prosthetic tools allow creative playstyles akin to a puzzle box
Its score by Yuka Kitamura and Hiroki Kikuta is considered a modern classic

games.title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
games.short_description: Build an empire to stand the test of time in the definitive 4X strategy game.
games.about: Lead a civilization from the first settlement to the space age. Research technologies, wage wars, spread religions, and shape history alongside leaders from across time. The famous "one more turn" hook has never been more addictive.
games.player_count: 11+ million copies sold
awards: Best Strategy Game 2016 nominee (The Game Awards)
trivia: Sean Bean narrates the tech tree — quoting actual historical figures
Every leader has an AI personality that shapes diplomacy
Its "one more turn" design is legendary among strategy fans
The Rise and Fall expansion introduced loyal and rebellious cities

games.title: Stardew Valley
games.short_description: A beloved farming sim where you build the life of your dreams.
games.about: You've inherited your grandfather's old farm plot in Stardew Valley. Armed with hand-me-down tools, set out to build a new life. Grow crops, raise animals, mine for treasure, befriend townsfolk, and maybe find love in this charming, endlessly relaxing farming adventure with surprising depth.
games.player_count: 41+ million copies sold; one of the best-selling indie games ever
trivia: It was created by a single developer, Eric Barone, over four years
Barone drew all the pixel art and wrote all the music himself
The game's community center replaced a last-minute "Joja warehouse" ending
Jas, one of the town's children, is named after Barone's sister

games.title: Team Fortress 2
games.short_description: Nine ridiculous classes, one legendary team-based shooter.
games.about: The comic, chaotic, endlessly influential hero shooter. Play as the Scout, the Spy, the Medic, and more in objective-based multiplayer mayhem. With decades of updates, an iconic art style, and a beloved community, TF2 is a true gaming institution.
games.player_count: One of the most-played Steam games for 15+ years
awards: Guinness World Record for most-patched game (2010s)
trivia: Its cartoon art style is based on the work of illustrator J.C. Leyendecker
Every class has a rich comic-book backstory, published free online
The Spy can disguise as any enemy class and backstab for instant kills
Its hat economy became a real phenomenon studied by economists

games.title: Terraria
games.short_description: Dig, fight, explore, build — a 2D sandbox adventure of endless depth.
games.about: In Terraria, the world is your canvas and the underground is your playground. Dig for treasure, fight huge bosses, build incredible structures, and craft thousands of items in this charming 2D sandbox. With tons of content and endless replayability, Terraria is a true indie legend.
games.player_count: 44+ million copies sold; one of the best-selling indie games ever
trivia: It has received over a decade of free content updates — a record for an indie game
The final "Journey's End" update added over 1,000 new items
The Moon Lord is a reference to the Lovecraftian Cthulhu mythos
It started as a Minecraft-meets-Metroid hybrid proposed on a forum

games.title: The Last of Us Part I
games.short_description: A heartbreaking post-apocalyptic journey of survival and love.
games.about: Joel, a hardened survivor, is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie out of a quarantine zone. What starts as a simple job becomes a brutal journey across a decimated America. With masterful storytelling, tense survival gameplay, and unforgettable characters, The Last of Us is one of gaming's greatest narratives.
games.player_count: Original sold 20+ million; Part I remake sold millions more
awards: Original won Game of the Year 2013; remake nominated for accessibility awards
trivia: The remake was rebuilt from scratch with modern lighting and animations
Its infected enemies are based on real Cordyceps fungi
The story of Joel and Ellie is considered a high-water mark for narrative games
The HBO adaptation, starring Pedro Pascal and Bella Ramsey, premiered in 2023

games.title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
games.short_description: An epic adventure across the land and skies of Hyrule.
games.about: In the sequel to Breath of the Wild, Link explores the sprawling skies and deep depths of Hyrule. With new abilities like Ultrahand and Fuse, you can craft weapons, build vehicles, and solve puzzles in a world that rewards creativity like no other.
games.player_count: 20+ million copies sold; fastest-selling Zelda game ever
trivia: Its fuse and ultrahand abilities let players build vehicles, machines, and more
The map is roughly triple the size of Breath of the Wild when counting the sky and depths
Nintendo released an official, free trading card of its Master Sword
Players found a way to defeat the final boss in under 2 minutes using creative ability stacking

games.title: The Sims 4
games.short_description: The world-famous life simulator, where you create and control people.
games.about: Build homes, design personalities, pursue careers, start families, and tell stories with the most beloved life sim ever made. Free to play with a decade of add-on content, The Sims 4 lets you play with life in any way you can imagine.
games.player_count: 70+ million players worldwide
trivia: It became free-to-play in October 2022
Its Create-a-Sim introduced customizable body types and skin tones
The Gallery lets players share houses and households worldwide
Emotions — happy, angry, embarrassed — drive its simulation, a first for the series

games.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
games.short_description: A story-driven RPG of monster hunting and moral ambiguity.
games.about: You are Geralt of Rivia, a monster slayer for hire, on a quest to find your adopted daughter in a war-torn world. With rich characters, meaningful choices, breathtaking landscapes, and two massive story expansions, The Witcher 3 set a new standard for open-world RPGs and remains a genre benchmark.
games.player_count: 50+ million copies sold; among the best-selling RPGs ever
awards: Game of the Year 2015 (The Game Awards)
Golden Joystick Ultimate Game of the Year 2015
trivia: CD Projekt Red promised no DRM and delivered
The Bloody Baron questline is taught in writing courses as an example of branching narrative
Gwent, an in-game card game, became its own standalone game
The game's "Evil Incarnate" ending was voted on by fans in Poland

games.title: Valheim
games.short_description: A brutal Viking survival saga for one to ten players.
games.about: Prove your worth to the Norse gods by conquering a procedurally generated world of forests, mountains, and seas. Build longhalls, craft legendary weapons, and summon and slay ancient beasts. Deep survival mechanics and cooperative play make Valheim a phenomenon.
games.player_count: 12+ million copies sold
awards: Best Debut Game 2021 nominee (The Game Awards)
trivia: It was made by a five-person studio in Sweden
Its procedural worlds are inspired by Norse mythology
Building, farming, and sailing are as important as combat
The name "Valheim" refers to the tenth world in Norse mythology
